remarks: Brand-new renovations and move-in ready in the heart of Huntington Beach! Every major finish has just been redone, so you can move right in. Brand-new luxury vinyl plank flooring runs throughout the home, and a fresh interior paint job gives every room a clean, bright feel. In the kitchen, brand-new quartz countertops add a modern, low-maintenance surface. New lighting fixtures brighten the whole home, and a brand-new sliding glass door opens to a private outdoor space.
